integrity: The formulas are proved for every sample size at least two by conditioning a uniform permutation on one fixed coordinate and by an exact variance calculation. Exhaustive enumeration through size nine is supplementary verification only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes a uniform permutation and no tied ranks.
It gives exact first-order mixed moments and a positional conditional mean, not the full joint law or higher mixed moments.
Older refined permutation-enumeration literature may encode the same joint statistic under another generating-function notation.
title: A parabolic fixed-point profile inside Spearman's permutation null
